scenes.chapter_title: Apple’s Health‑AI Study App: 200,000 Users, 12‑Month Data Surge
scenes.narration: The app lives inside the Apple Health menu, so users don’t even need a separate download. They ask health questions, receive AI‑generated answers, then rate each response. Apple uses these ratings to refine the bot’s accuracy, creating a feedback loop that powers tomorrow’s health tech. This is real data, not simulated chats.

scenes.chapter_title: Apple’s Health‑AI Study App: 200,000 Users, 12‑Month Data Surge
scenes.narration: OpenEvidence, Apple’s partner, manages the data collection and analysis. scenes.chapter_title: Apple’s Health‑AI Study App: 200,000 Users, 12‑Month Data Surge
